SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      coalesce(agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, 'day'), '') AS local_day,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
      SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
      SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_write_input_tokens),0) AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) AS cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(cache_read_input_tokens),0) AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) AS cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN input_tokens END),0) AS c_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN output_tokens END),0) AS c_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN total_tokens END),0) AS c_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS c_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN duration_ms END) AS c_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS c_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS c_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS c_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS c_duration_missing,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END),0) AS r_input_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END),0) AS r_output_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END),0) AS r_total_tokens,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END),0) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) AS r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      coalesce(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN 1.0 * duration_ms END),0) AS r_duration_ms,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS r_duration_ms_known,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS r_exact,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS r_derived,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS r_approximate,
      SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS r_duration_missing,
      MIN(started_at_ms) AS min_started_at_ms
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM turn_summary t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE 1 = 1
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id, local_day
